# Minecraft Version(s): 26.3
## Changes:
- Improved server performance of the Event HUD, Coordinates HUD and sleep tracking (player data is no longer read every second)
- Repeating background tasks now start a few ticks apart after loading instead of all on the same tick, spreading out server load

## Fixes:
- Players sleeping in Straw Beds not counting toward skipping the night
- Back buttons in menus being labelled "Teleport Back"

releases.notes:
# Minecraft Version(s): 26.3
## Changes:
- Added "Teleport Back" action returning players to where they were before their last random, spawn or home teleport (configurable cost & cooldown)
- Added a configurable teleport warm-up for random, spawn, home & back teleports (cancelled when moving, taking damage or disconnecting)
- Setting a home now asks for confirmation when a home is already set
- Coordinates HUD now also shows the light level at a players position
- Event leaderboard with the top 3 players shown to event participants when an event ends

## Fixes:
- Some statistic messages not working

readmeSummary: This data pack also works as the required resource pack. Just put the same file into your resourcepacks folder and enable it in game.
